questions.question: What should you include in a devising portfolio to achieve a high mark?

points.text: Stimulus analysis, research evidence, exploration techniques used, rehearsal process, key decisions and their justification, practitioner influence with examples, reflection on strengths and weaknesses, evaluation of the final piece's impact on the audience.

questions.question: Explain the difference between describing what you did and evaluating why you did it. Why is evaluation more important?

points.text: Description: 'We used a freeze-frame.' Evaluation: 'We used a freeze-frame to mark the moment when the truth was revealed, creating a pause that allowed the audience to absorb the significance — this Brechtian technique forced critical reflection rather than emotional response.'

questions.question: How would you document the influence of a practitioner on your devised piece?

points.text: Name the practitioner; explain the specific technique or idea used; describe how you applied it in rehearsal; evaluate its effect on the final piece; analyse how it shaped the audience's experience.
